tactical-vest.name: Tactical Vest
tactical-vest.info: Default light armor set for soldiers and recruits. Offers enhanced protection with greatly improved mobility. Equippable by all Biosoldiers.

tactical-armor.name: Tactical Armor
tactical-armor.info: Default heavy armor set for soldiers and recruits. Offers enhanced protection with limited mobility. Equippable by all Biosoldiers.

phalanx-armor.name: Phalanx Armor
phalanx-armor.info: Offers enhanced protection with improved mobility. Light armor set. Equippable by all Biosoldiers.

carapace-armor.name: Carapace Armor
carapace-armor.info: Offers enhanced protection. Heavy armor set. Equippable by all Biosoldiers.

kestrel-armor.name: Kestrel Armor
kestrel-armor.info: Offers enhanced protection with greatly improved mobility and defense. Equipped with a grappling hook for tactical positioning. Light armor set. Equippable by all Biosoldiers.

aegis-armor.name: Aegis Armor
aegis-armor.info: Provides greatly enhanced protection and mobility. Heavy armor set. Equippable by all Biosoldiers.

banshee-armor.name: Banshee Armor
banshee-armor.info: Offers enhanced protection and greatly improved mobility. Equipped with a grappling hook for tactical positioning. Light armor set. Equippable by all Biosoldiers.

corsair-armor.name: Corsair Armor
corsair-armor.info: This equipment never requires repairs. Offers enhanced protection and greatly improved mobility. Equipped with a grappling hook for tactical positioning. Light armor set. Equippable by all Biosoldiers.

titan-armor.name: Titan Armor
titan-armor.info: This equipment never requires repairs. Offers greatly enhanced protection with immunity to strangulation. Heavy armor set. Equippable by all Biosoldiers.

seraph-armor.name: Seraph Armor
seraph-armor.info: Offers greatly enhanced protection with limited flight capability. Flying sets mobility to 9.3, increases defense by +30, and avoids the crit bonus exposed targets receive. Flight take off, hovering, and movement costs 1 fuel. Toggle flight mode to initiate flying. Light armor set. Equippable by all classes except MEC.

archangel-armor.name: Archangel Armor
archangel-armor.info: This equipment never requires repairs. Offers greatly enhanced protection while airborne with limited flight capability. Flying sets mobility to 9.3, increases defense by +30, and avoids the crit bonus exposed targets receive. Flight take off, hovering, and movement costs 1 fuel. Toggle flight mode to initiate flying. Provides immunity to strangulation. Heavy armor set. Equippable by all Biosoldiers.

ghost-armor.name: Ghost Armor
ghost-armor.info: This equipment never requires repairs. Offers enhanced protection with greatly improved defense. Equipped with a grappling hook for tactical positioning. Light armor set. Equippable by all Biosoldiers.

aurora-armor.name: Aurora Armor
aurora-armor.info: Offers enhanced protection with improved mobility. Increases wearers psionic capabilities. Light armor set. Equippable by Psi only.

vortex-armor.name: Vortex Armor
vortex-armor.info: This equipment never requires repairs. Offers enhanced protection with increased mental fortitude. Gollop Chamber activation requires this armor and a soldier with the Fervor ability. Reduces post-battle fatigue. Heavy armor set. Equippable by Psi only.
